Studio Kora

Every thread, a quiet pilgrimage.

Studio Kora reimagines the Tibetan chuba and its silken details — kimono brocades, hand‑finished collars, freshwater pearl and turquoise trims — for women who carry their heritage with quiet pride. Handcrafted in the hill town of Kalimpong.

View the Collection Follow on Instagram

Our Story

The Circle We Walk

In Tibetan Buddhist practice, a kora is a sacred circumambulation — a walk taken in devotion, around a monastery, a stupa, a mountain. Studio Kora borrows this idea of the unbroken circle: heritage carried forward, stitch by stitch, from our studio in Kalimpong.

Every piece begins with fabric chosen for its story — brocades gathered along old Himalayan trade routes, silk collars finished entirely by hand, closures dressed in freshwater pearl and turquoise in the manner of traditional Tibetan jewellery. What emerges is the chuba re‑imagined: structured, wearable, and entirely our own.

Heritage

Silhouettes drawn from generations of Tibetan and Himalayan dress.

Handcraft

Cut, draped and finished entirely by hand in our Kalimpong studio.

Community

Made in small batches, for the women who wear their roots well.
